# ASTU Muslim Jemea

> Islamic community platform for ASTU Muslim students — prayer times, Quran, Hadith, lectures, donations, Khadims and community portals.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Welcome and registration entry point.
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Personal dashboard for signed-in members.
- [Resources](/resources): Quran, Hadith, lectures and Islamic library.
- [Prayer Times](/prayer-times): Daily prayer times and Qibla direction.
- [News & Events](/news): Community announcements and events.
- [Donations](/donations): Active donation campaigns and history.
- [Khadims](/khadims): Volunteer scheduling, especially for Ramadan.
- [Ramadan](/ramadan): Ramadan programme and meal cards.
- [Community](/community): Group chats and member discussions.
- [Groups](/groups): Student group system (14-student units).
- [Governance](/governance): Leadership, Amirs and committees.
- [Academic](/academic): Academic resources and study support.
- [Challenges](/challenges): Spiritual and learning challenges.

## Optional

- [Dua](/dua), [Hadith](/hadith), [Adhkar](/adhkar), [Tasbih](/tasbih), [Azan](/azan)
- [Services](/services), [Support](/support)
